# Figure S3 : Utilitity Function
# Display the utility function mean for each individual and the mean of all individual means in gains and losses


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# --- Fonction utilité ---
u <- function(x, rho_g, rho_l, lambdaraw) {
  ifelse(x > 0, x^(1 - rho_g), -lambdaraw * (-x)^(1 + rho_l))
}

# --- Découpage du elo en 3 classes ---
elo_min <- min(filtered_data$elo, na.rm = TRUE)
elo_max <- max(filtered_data$elo, na.rm = TRUE)
tier1 <- elo_min + (elo_max - elo_min) / 3
tier2 <- elo_min + 2 * (elo_max - elo_min) / 3

filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
  mutate(elo_class = case_when(
    elo <= tier1 ~ "low",
    elo <= tier2 ~ "middle",
    TRUE         ~ "high"
  )) %>%
  mutate(elo_class = factor(elo_class, levels = c("low", "middle", "high")))

# --- Valeurs x ---
x_values <- seq(-1, 1, length.out = 1000)

# --- Utilité individuelle ---
all_individuals <- filtered_data %>%
  group_by(monkey, elo_class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rho_g = mean(rho_g, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rho_l = mean(rho_l, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_lambda = mean(lambdaraw, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(util_values = list(sapply(x_values, u,
                                   rho_g = mean_rho_g,
                                   rho_l = mean_rho_l,
                                   lambdaraw = mean_lambda)),
         x_value = list(x_values)) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(util_values, x_value))

# --- Courbe globale par classe ---
global_means <- filtered_data %>%
  group_by(elo_class) %>%
  summarise(
    global_rho_g = mean(rho_g, na.rm = TRUE),
    global_rho_l = mean(rho_l, na.rm = TRUE),
    global_lambda = mean(lambdaraw, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(util_values = list(sapply(x_values, u,
                                   rho_g = global_rho_g,
                                   rho_l = global_rho_l,
                                   lambdaraw = global_lambda)),
         x_value = list(x_values)) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(util_values, x_value))

global_means <- global_means %>%
  mutate(x_sign = ifelse(x_value >= 0, "positive", "negative"))

# --- Texte pour les moyennes globales (affiché sur les panels) ---
annotation_data <- global_means %>%
  distinct(elo_class, global_rho_g, global_rho_l, global_lambda) %>%
  mutate(label = sprintf("ρ+=%.2f\nρ-=%.2f\nλ=%.2f",
                         global_rho_g, global_rho_l, global_lambda))

# --- Plot ---
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = all_individuals,
            aes(x = x_value, y = util_values, group = monkey),
            color = "darkgray", alpha = 1, size = 0.7) +
  geom_line(data = global_means,
            aes(x = x_value, y = util_values, color = x_sign),
            size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~elo_class, scales = "fixed") +
  geom_text(
    data = annotation_data,
    aes(x = 0.7, y = -5, label = label),
    hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 5, color = "black", fontface = "italic"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("positive" = "skyblue", "negative" = "orange")) +
  labs(x = "x", y = "u(x)", color = "Sign of x") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 26),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 26),
    axis.text = element_text(angle = 90, size = 16),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  ylim(-5, 1)

```
